method.scope: Current working tree, tracked/untracked/ignored TS and TSX source, including unfinished changes. No uppercase .TS/.TSX files found.
method.enumeration: rg --files --hidden --no-ignore; exclude node_modules, dist, build, .next*, .git, coverage, .turbo, test-results, playwright-report, .tmp.
method.analysis: TypeScript 6.0.3 AST: string/template literals, entity-code assignments/comparisons, known metadata/DDL permission vocabulary, permission-containing declarations, MFA identifiers/literals/boolean settings, and selected permission-presence/parser guards. Comments alone do not count.
method.counting: A category count is distinct files; categories overlap. anyCandidate is their union. Scope classes are exclusive. Findings count AST locations, not independent bugs.
method.classification: Tests/specs/test helpers/fixtures separated from tooling/scripts, declarations/generated sources, and remaining application source. Application source includes contracts, adapters, development hosts and platform infrastructure; not every file is reachable in DEV.
limits: Static review is not a reachability or deployment audit.
Literal names may be model properties, schema contracts or registered domain identities rather than improper behavior.
MFA identifier references include generic IAM/session implementation and are not evidence of unapproved MFA requirements.
Prior human approval history cannot be established from source alone.
Heuristics can miss aliases, indirect maps, concatenations and names outside the discovered vocabulary. The scan is exhaustive over the stated file inventory, not proof of every semantic violation.

SQL, JSON, MJS, CJS, JS, JSX, YAML and .mts/.cts are not counted; metadata JSON and DDL are consulted only to discover vocabulary. Database policy values and authorization effects were not changed or exhaustively audited.
Missing permission must remain distinct from unsupported operation, invalid metadata, missing active publication, explicit deny or cross-tenant scope.
